sloka: एषा प्रसन्न सलिला पद्म नील उत्पलायुता ।हंस कारण्डव आकीर्णा पम्पा सौगन्धिका युता ॥४-१-६३॥
transliteration: eṣā prasanna salilā padma nīla utpalāyutā ।haṁsa kāraṇḍava ākīrṇā pampā saugandhikā yutā ॥4-1-63॥

translations.english: 'Lake Pampa shines with lotuses with bees on their filaments like the rising sun.
